title: A finite area that never ends
caption: The curve y = xe^(−x²) never reaches the axis, yet the area under it from 0 to b is ½ − ½e^(−b²), which tends to ½: the improper integral converges to ½. By x = 3 the curve is already almost flat on the axis.
alt: The curve y = xe^(−x²) rising to a peak of about 0.43 at x = 0.71 and then decaying towards zero, with the area under it from 0 to 4 shaded.

checks.name: the area from 0 to 6 is already ½ − ½e⁻³⁶ ≈ ½
